# QuietReplay

> Records what you do on a Chrome page and saves a file on your computer. Press Record, then Stop and save. Nothing is sent online, and there is no account. It is a local MV3 extension: the whole tab session (what you did, page messages, requests, screenshots, optional video) in a ZIP, with no network calls.
